compile.nuance: Broadest catch-all in the batch: 'Did the appraisal report meet Fannie Mae appraisal requirements?' behind one exception code (O-FNM-59385) stands in for the entire B4-1 appraisal chapter. B4-1.3-01 (Review of the Appraisal Report) is the umbrella section and itself cross-references B2-3-01 (property eligibility), B4-1.3-12 (appraisal quality matters/value support), and B4-1.1-04 (unacceptable appraisal practices) as the three pillars of 'meeting requirements.' None of those pillars are separately enumerated as defect options on this card, so a single check_type/citation cannot represent the real requirement set. Decomposition required; target_sections lists the four-section umbrella scope pending children.
